name: haravan
description: Turn Haravan shop data into sales and profit reports, channel and product breakdowns, order lists, and low-stock and inventory summaries, and confirm, close, cancel or tag orders after you approve each change.

interface.shortDescription: Sales and stock insights from Haravan
interface.longDescription: Haravan for ChatGPT helps authorized merchants understand sales and stock and manage orders in their connected shop. Ask for net sales, profit or quantity sold over a period, compare this week with the previous week, see a day-by-day trend, break sales down by channel, product, branch or province, find orders created yesterday that are still unfulfilled, see which products are about to run out, or check stock on hand by branch. Sales and stock figures come from Haravan Reports; order lists come from the shop's orders. Reports state the requested date range and the metrics used, and are limited by the shop's permissions and available data. It can also confirm, close, re-open or cancel orders and add or remove order tags: every change is first shown on a confirmation card and runs only after the merchant presses Confirm. It does not create orders, issue refunds, edit products or adjust stock directly.
capabilities: Read connected order, sales and inventory data
Summarize sales performance, fulfillment and stock levels
Confirm, close, re-open, cancel and tag orders after the merchant confirms
defaultPrompt: Compare this week with last week: net sales, profit, and quantity sold.
For yesterday, list every order still unfulfilled and give me the count.
Which products will run out of stock soonest, and at which branch?
